title: Assembly Line Digital Twin
thesis: Snowflake powers the digital twin data layer for 8 assembly lines, detecting equipment anomalies, forecasting downtime events, and enabling 3D visualization — replacing fragmented SCADA systems with unified analytics

talking_points: Four hundred twenty million baht in unplanned downtime cost across 8 assembly lines this quarter.
Average OEE at 72.3% — target is 85%. Two lines below 65%.
Nineteen equipment stations showing degradation patterns.
show: Point at the ฿420M downtime cost KPI
tabs.call_out: ฿420M downtime cost — OEE 13 points below target

transition.line: Let's see which stations are predicted to fail next.

talking_points: 3D visualization of Line-02 body shop — 30 robot stations color-coded by health score.
Station W-12 (welding robot) showing amber — vibration trending up 40% over 14 days.
Click any station to see real-time telemetry and predicted time-to-failure.
show: Click W-12 to expand telemetry panel
Point at health score color gradient
tabs.call_out: Visual digital twin — backed by Snowflake Dynamic Tables

transition.line: Let's look at the predictive maintenance analytics.

talking_points: ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION flags 19 stations with abnormal vibration patterns.
ML.FORECAST predicts Station W-12 will exceed failure threshold in 4 days.
Maintenance window recommendation: schedule PM during upcoming Saturday shift.
show: Display forecast with failure threshold line
tabs.call_out: 4 days to failure predicted — proactive PM saves ฿15M per event

transition.line: Now let the Plant Director ask the system directly.

talking_points: Chaiwat asks: 'What's our total unplanned downtime cost this month by line?'
Cortex Analyst: Line-02 ฿87M, Line-05 ฿64M, Line-07 ฿52M.
Switch to advisor: 'What maintenance should we prioritize this week?' — recommends based on health scores and production schedule.
show: Type: 'Unplanned downtime cost by line this month'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + maintenance advisory

talking_points: Eight Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
IoT Core + TwinMaker provide ingestion and visualization; Snowflake provides the analytical brain.
Thailand's auto sector: 1.88M vehicles/year. This monitors 8 lines, 240 stations, 750K daily readings.
tabs.call_out: Digital twin visualization + ML analytics — one data platform

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for automotive digital twins in Thailand.
